culpritSource.quote: Akito Haga is the culprit behind a robbery eight years ago. His motive for buying the house was to retrieve the money he had stolen and buried in the backyard. After realizing the money was used by the previous owner and was likely the source for the gardener killing his spouse, he becomes disgruntled. After Akari finds out about his motive, he tries to kill her, which was part of his original plan.

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, the Detective Boys and the married couple Akari Haga and Akito Haga are fixing the traditional house when Akari notices the strange stains at the wall near her husband, so he decides to touch it with his trowel, breaking it easily for some reason. This catches the attention of the kids as the Detective Boys assume there must be a treasure inside the wall. However, to everyone’s horror, the content inside the wall is the corpse of a woman. While the police are investigating, Conan notices that the corpse was wearing pajamas before she died, so he and his friends begin asking the couple about the house but it yields no result since nothing much about the former owner is revealed.
